description: This PHP source file defines the TimesheetDao class responsible for data access operations related to timesheets in the OrangeHRM HR management system. It includes methods to retrieve, save, and manipulate timesheet entities, their items, and associated logs, as well as generating reports and handling filtering and pagination.

classes.name: TimesheetDao
classes.description: This class manages database operations for timesheets, including CRUD operations, report generation, filtering, and pagination within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getTimesheetById
methods.description: Retrieves a Timesheet entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveTimesheet
methods.description: Saves a Timesheet entity to the database.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemByTimesheetIdAndTimesheetItemId
methods.description: Retrieves a TimesheetItem by its ID and associated timesheet ID.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemsByTimesheetId
methods.description: Retrieves all TimesheetItems associated with a given timesheet ID.

methods.name: saveTimesheetItem
methods.description: Saves a TimesheetItem entity.

methods.name: saveTimesheetActionLog
methods.description: Records an action log related to a timesheet.

methods.name: hasTimesheetForStartDate
methods.description: Checks if a timesheet exists for an employee on a specific start date.

methods.name: getTimesheetActionLogs
methods.description: Fetches action logs for a particular timesheet based on search filters.

methods.name: getTimesheetActionLogsPaginator
methods.description: Prepares a paginated query for timesheet action logs.

methods.name: getTimesheetActionLogsCount
methods.description: Counts the number of action logs for a timesheet based on filters.

methods.name: getTimesheetByStartAndEndDate
methods.description: Retrieves timesheets within a date range based on filters.

methods.name: getTimesheetCount
methods.description: Returns the count of timesheets matching filters.

methods.name: deleteTimesheetRows
methods.description: Deletes specific rows (entries) from a timesheet based on project and activity IDs.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateTimesheetItems
methods.description: Persists new or updated timesheet items, managing duplicates and updates.

methods.name: isDuplicateTimesheetItem
methods.description: Checks for duplicate timesheet item entries for a specific project, activity, and timesheet combination.

methods.name: getEmployeeTimesheetList
methods.description: Gets a list of timesheets for employees based on search filters.

methods.name: getEmployeeTimesheetPaginator
methods.description: Prepares a paginated query for employee timesheets.

methods.name: getEmployeeTimesheetListCount
methods.description: Returns total count of employee timesheets matching filters.

methods.name: getDefaultTimesheet
methods.description: Retrieves the default timesheet for an employee based on date filters.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemsForEmployeeReport
methods.description: Fetches timesheet items formatted for employee reports.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemsCountForEmployeeReport
methods.description: Counts timesheet items for employee reports.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemsPaginatorForEmployeeReport
methods.description: Creates a paginator for employee report timesheet items.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemsForEmployeeReportQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds a query for employee report timesheet items.

methods.name: getTotalDurationForEmployeeReport
methods.description: Calculates total duration for employee report timesheet items.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemByProjectIdAndTimesheetIdAndActivityIdAndDate
methods.description: Fetches a specific timesheet item based on project, timesheet, activity IDs, and date.
